rationale: Identity was verified correctly using full name and zip, and the agent acted on the correct delivered order. However, two critical issues: (1) The agent executed the exchange write immediately after the user selected the item and payment method, without providing a clear pre-write confirmation summarizing the exact change and receiving explicit consent, which the policy requires. (2) The user asked to keep all other specifications the same except for maximizing zoom; the agent proceeded with a 30MP model while the original was 24MP, changing specs beyond zoom. Additionally, the chosen new item ID was not explicitly surfaced in tool results shown, and maximum zoom across matching-spec options was not verified. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
